packs.name: AmbientCG PBR Textures
packs.creator: AmbientCG (Lennart Demes)
packs.description: Extensive collection of 100% CC0 public domain PBR materials and surface textures by Lennart Demes (ambientcg.com) in max 512px KTX2 format with full mipmaps for fast scene prototyping and low VRAM usage. Master resolutions (up to 8K/12K) available via original source links.

packs.name: Kenney: Particle Textures Pack
packs.creator: Kenney
packs.description: Over 80 particle, fire, smoke, star, flare, spark, and VFX textures by Kenney (kenney.nl) in max 512px KTX2 format. CC0 1.0 Universal.

packs.name: Kenney: Prototype Textures
packs.creator: Kenney
packs.description: Universal development and blockout grid prototype textures (dark, light, orange, green, red, purple grids with meter units) by Kenney (kenney.nl) in max 512px KTX2 format. CC0 1.0 Universal.

packs.name: Poly Haven PBR Textures
packs.creator: Poly Haven
packs.description: Curated collection of 100% CC0 photorealistic PBR materials by Poly Haven (polyhaven.com) in max 512px KTX2 format with full mipmaps for fast scene prototyping and low VRAM usage. High-resolution master files (up to 8K/16K) available via original source links.
